Q: better-sqlite3 Update the row value (SqliteError: unrecognized token: ":") A:

better-sqlite3 expects bound parameters, not raw values injected into the query. Change:

db.prepare(`UPDATE app_schema SET _c_url = ${_c_url_json.login_api}`)

To:

db.prepare(`UPDATE app_schema SET _c_url = ?`).run(_c_url_json.login_api)

Use ? or named parameters. This is required in better-sqlite3. With ?:

const stmt = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE app_schema
    SET _c_url = ?
`);
stmt.run(_c_url_json.login_api);

With named parameters:

const stmt = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE app_schema
    SET _c_url = :url
`);
stmt.run({ url: _c_url_json.login_api });

Q: Visual Studio Code auto completion A:

Try this:

  1. Open Visual Studio Code

  2. Press Cmd + Shift + P

  3. Type or select Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)

  4. Press Enter

  5. Then paste:

{
  "editor.autoCloseTags": false,
  "html.autoClosingTags": false
}

Save it then exit Visual Studio Code. Open Visual Studio Code and write your .html file without autocomplete.

Q: What is the most efficient way to implement branching with a large number of outcomes in C++? A:

std::map lookup is O(log n), std::unordered_map<char,std::fuction<void (char)>> is O(1) (amoratized). So I probably would use that
